title: GPOM War
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ the first battle between autonomous armies
moodboard_intro: Swindon today, no humans anywhere, never a hit on screen: drone swarms, empty motorways and roundabouts, the armies meeting, the wreckage after. Dashed cards are what's on the timeline now. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per beat.
storyboard_intro: Frames in story order. Pick one still and one way to animate each.

beats.name: The swarm arrives
beats.blurb: Out of chorus 2's white-out into a white sky: the swarm comes over Swindon.

beats.name: The motorway
beats.blurb: The M4, empty: drones skimming the carriageway, robots crossing the bridge.

beats.name: The town
beats.blurb: High street, roundabouts, terraces: lights cycling for nobody, machines passing through.

beats.name: The drone feed
beats.blurb: A try (Kai): the war as drone-camera footage, grey or thermal, looking down. Maybe we use it, maybe not.

beats.name: The armies meet
beats.blurb: Two sides in the fields: swarm into swarm, lines across a trench, the shredded tree line.

beats.name: The remnants
beats.blurb: Never the hit, only what is left: crashed drones on roundabouts, in hedges, on the hard shoulder.
